title: Let Prompts Bridge Defense Knowledge: Transferable Graph Purification via Vulnerability-Aware GPL
abstract: arXiv:2608.29054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone for representing complex relational dependencies in diverse multimedia tasks, particularly in cross-platform user interest modeling and cross-modal semantic alignment. In the real world, a practical defense against graph adversarial perturbations is needed. However, we observe that the prevailing adversarial purification methods are essentially domain-restricted defenses, which leads to the following shortcomings: (1) single-domain data provides insufficient structural and semantic diversity for learning robust purification criteria; (2) training of domain-specific defense strategies from scratch consumes substantial computational cost. To address the above limitations, we propose a transferable graph purification scheme, named ProGAP, to bridge adversarial defense knowledge via vulnerability-aware graph prompt learning. translated_title: 让提示词桥接防御知识：基于漏洞感知GPL的可迁移图净化
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）已成为在多样化多媒体任务中表示复杂关系依赖的基石，尤其是在跨平台用户兴趣建模和跨模态语义对齐方面。在现实世界中，需要一种能够抵御图对抗扰动的实用防御方法。然而，我们观察到，目前主流的对抗净化方法本质上是领域受限的防御，这导致了以下缺陷：（1）单领域数据无法为学习鲁棒的净化准则提供足够的结构和语义多样性；（2）从头训练特定领域的防御策略会消耗大量计算成本。为解决上述局限性，我们提出了一种可迁移的图净化方案，命名为ProGAP，通过漏洞感知的图提示学习来桥接对抗防御知识。首先，为了捕获通用的对抗模式，一个扰动……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ProGAP，一种基于漏洞感知图提示学习的可迁移图净化方案，通过桥接跨领域对抗防御知识，解决了现有净化方法领域受限、数据多样性不足和计算成本高昂的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ProGAP, a transferable graph purification scheme via vulnerability-aware graph prompt learning, which bridges cross-domain adversarial defense knowledge to overcome the domain-restricted nature, insufficient data diversity, and high computational costs of existing purification methods.
